the electrophoretic profiles of cytoplasmic-polyhedrosis-virus isolates correlate with the antigenic properties and that the agarose-gel method is most useful for the classification of cytoplasmal polyhedrosis viruses into electropherotype groups.

the electropherotype of CPV is a useful classification criterion and the results obtained by agarose gel electroporesis showed a close correlation to the antigenic properties.
